next_action.description: Run the Step 2b clone test: generate a voice with the Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign HF Space (Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-Voice-Design), feed that clip to Chatterbox on the bench (G:/ComfyUi, port 8188, TTS_Chatterbox_all-nodes.json is already staged), and judge whether a synthetic reference clones acceptably. Fabio must HEAR it - the plan's verify mode is user-ux.

key_decisions: API-patching Qwen onto transformers 5 is ABANDONED - it was break #4 and #5 of an unbounded series against an unresponsive upstream (PR #201 closed unmerged, #157 open since June, 100 forks/0 stars).
Branch A (ship a self-provisioning isolated runtime in the app) is PARKED, not rejected - Fabio: 'still sounds a bit dangerous to our app'. Kept fully costed in plan.md so it can be revived.

A curated library of REAL voices is the wrong shape: it puts Vision in the Lehrman v. Lovo posture (the entity that collected, held and distributed voice profiles). A licence does not cure right-of-publicity or GDPR Art. 9.

Fabio's LATEST direction (this is the live one): a voice DESIGNER driven per character, not a picker - because users create characters in the character sheet and each deserves an original voice. An offline-authored library becomes the seed set, not the answer.
Voice design sends TEXT only, no reference clip - so it carries no biometric data and can run remotely with none of the GDPR concern that attaches to cloning.
constraints: Vision installs ONE curated lock in ONE --no-deps pass; a node's requirements.txt is never read, but `uv pip compile` DOES resolve the closure, so any dep conflict fails loudly. numpy==2.5.1 vs the suite's <2.3.0 is the proven hard conflict.

The Windows engine python is the EMBEDDABLE distribution (3.13.12, python313._pth) and has NO venv module - verified. Any local isolated runtime must bootstrap through pip-installed virtualenv, which is unverified against the ._pth that disables site.

EU AI Act Art. 50 has been IN FORCE since 2026-08-02. Vision is the provider; synthetic audio output must carry machine-readable marking. Perth covers the shape; Code of Practice conformance is UNVERIFIED. Penalty EUR 15M / 3% turnover.

ELVIS Act (TN) attaches civil AND criminal liability to distributing a tool whose 'primary purpose or function' is producing a particular identifiable individual's voice - this is a MARKETING trap: never describe the feature as celebrity or individual cloning.

The bench (G:/ComfyUi, port 8188) is on transformers 5.13.0 with a patched ComfyUI-QwenTTS. Those patches are now dead weight - do not spend more time on them. A ComfyUI-Manager update reverts them anyway. Rollback line in research/bench_rollback.txt.
Shell has NO network egress (curl returns 000 for every host); only agent WebFetch/WebSearch reach the internet. Do not conclude a site is down from a failed curl.
DAPS, Expresso, EARS and Emilia are all CC BY-NC - commercially unusable, despite being otherwise ideal. Same NC trap inside kyutai/tts-voices' expresso/ and ears/ subdirs.
